verses.english: “A fool is known by three things.

verses.pali: Ayoniso pañhaṁ kattā hoti, ayoniso pañhaṁ vissajjetā hoti, parassa kho pana yoniso pañhaṁ vissajjitaṁ parimaṇḍalehi padabyañjanehi siliṭṭhehi upagatehi nābbhanumoditā hoti.
verses.english: They ask a question irrationally. They answer a question irrationally. And when someone else answers a question rationally—with well-rounded, coherent, and relevant words and phrases—they disagree with it.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bālo veditabbo.
verses.english: These are the three things by which a fool is known.

verses.pali: Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabbo.
verses.english: An astute person is known by three things.

verses.pali: Yoniso pañhaṁ kattā hoti, yoniso pañhaṁ vissajjetā hoti, parassa kho pana yoniso pañhaṁ vissajjitaṁ parimaṇḍalehi padabyañjanehi siliṭṭhehi upagatehi abbhanumoditā hoti.
verses.english: They ask a question rationally. They answer a question rationally. And when someone else answers a question rationally—with well-rounded, coherent, and relevant words and phrases—they agree with it.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabbo.
verses.english: These are the three things by which an astute person is known.
